# Pasithea Therapeutics Announces Participation in Two September 2026 Investor Conferences


September 03, 2026 4:05pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e8d45e23e30e44e876a05a612804e40b/pasithea/news/2026-09-03_Pasithea_Therapeutics_Announces_Participation_in_147.pdf)


*-- Company will hold one-on-one investor meetings at the 12th Annual Cantor Global Healthcare Conference (September 9-11) and will present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference (September 14-16) --*


MIAMI, Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Pasithea Therapeutics Corp.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1hnGoOy0_79jkpxk2PsJQ37XCEyki7wrmNaTaaw6Fmby_ZvgPuHKeHzp6P7XRH-x0-9vZnHuTLPns3rRhfa9XNmZ6oXl0WL5-w1_uGwziy4=) (NASDAQ: KTTA) ("Pasithea" or the "Company"), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing PAS-004, a next-generation macrocyclic oral MEK inhibitor, for the long-term treatment of chronic diseases including the neurocutaneous manifestations of neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), today announced that management will participate in two investor conferences taking place in September 2026: the 12th Annual Cantor Global Healthcare Conference, hosted by Cantor Fitzgerald, and the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference.


**12th Annual Cantor Global Healthcare Conference**


Management will hold one-on-one investor meetings at the 12th Annual Cantor Global Healthcare Conference, taking place September 9-11, 2026, in New York, NY.


**H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference**


Management will also present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, being held September 14-16, 2026, with the Company's presentation scheduled for **Monday, September 14, 2026, at 2:30 PM ET** .


**About Pasithea Therapeutics Corp.**


Pasithea is a clinical-stage biotechnology company primarily focused on the research and development of its lead drug candidate, PAS-004, a next-generation macrocyclic MEK inhibitor intended for the treatment of RASopathies, MAPK pathway-driven tumors, and other diseases. The Company is currently testing PAS-004 in a Phase 1 clinical trial in advanced cancer patients ([NCT06299839](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mkWqSylIUUgSfVeYhRFv19huRPPVmMNy5900izPnRJVGzqMpUuJSrFBVElEyrk58qqjLfpin8TDyFeEW6FDj2ojfdo9xIWZUGIx-0uKOSVnxV1-47YTpOBmfHi6Bo1XA) ), and a Phase 1/1b clinical trial in adult patients with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1)-associated plexiform neurofibromas ([NCT06961565](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mkWqSylIUUgSfVeYhRFv17LibkV5hIpR1EqrZ3dmz6v563jWTeK2JeYqN_Y6Rcmdb9A8ZywkbcRed79I1hRuLY5IxmGucHQO4TZIdbaqZO5Ys_dvM8-VYBbCWN6hjDOM) ).
